value.message: I read Cartwheels Gym Centre's programs page for Cartwheel Gym - their site lists Tiny Gym for 1 (walking) to 3 year olds with a parent, $140 per term, with weekday and weekend slots, though I could not confirm a fall term or dates, and Halton Hills Gymnastics lists Parent and Tot (18 months to 3.11), also unconfirmed. I'll keep watching and text you when fall details post.
